messages.author: 0f089686f8ad364c
messages.subject: lod score from mqmscan
parts:
Hi,
I have some peaks in my plot from mqmscan of which I would like to have the lodscore and marker names.

I already used fitqtl() which is helpful, but I would like to have the lod-score which I see in my mqmplot.multitrait() as they are different from each other.
How can I do this?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] lod score from mqmscan
parts:
If 'result' is an object produced by mqmscan, you can use summary(result) to get the maximum LOD score on each chromosome.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] lod score from mqmscan
parts:
The result of mqmscan(), if you use multiple phenotype columns, is a list of data frames.

To get the peak LOD scores on each chromosome for the first trait, you could use

summary(result[[1]])

To get the summaries for all traits, you can use

lapply(result, summary)

karl
